topics.title: What is a Web3 Wallet?
topics.summary: How wallets store keys, sign transactions, and act as your identity on chain.
topics.content: A wallet is a cryptographic key manager. It stores private keys, signs transactions, and proves ownership on blockchains. Wallets can be custodial or non-custodial. Examples include MetaMask and hardware wallets like Ledger.

topics.title: Private Keys & Seed Phrases
topics.summary: What private keys and seed phrases are and how to protect them.
topics.content: Private keys are the secret binary that gives you control of your account. Seed phrases are human readable backups. Never share them or store them in plain text.
